title: Arachin daf 9

chapters.title: Rav Papa on the Pasuk
chapters.about: Tzedkatecha Kehar Re'el and Mishpatecha Tehom Raba

chapters.title: Rav Huna and Ula on calendar math
chapters.about: Calculating the offset of Rosh Hashanah

summary: Rabbi Soffer examines the Mishna in Masekhet Arachin regarding the laws of seclusion for Tzara'at and the rules governing the lunar calendar. He explores the mathematical constraints on the number of 30-day and 29-day months in a year to ensure holidays like Rosh Hashanah and Shabuot align correctly. The class also discusses the debate between Tanna Kamma and Rashbag concerning the length of a leap year month.
questions: Why is the seclusion period for Tzara'at different for a person versus a house?
What are the minimum and maximum number of 30-day months allowed in a year?
How do the rabbis ensure that Rosh Hashanah does not fall too early or too late relative to the new moon?
Does the calendar have to be set based on witnesses, or can it be fixed mathematically?
